candidates.change_summary: Replace the final `return true;` with `return false;` so a completing call returns false instead of true.
Remove the require(_tos.length > 0) check so an empty array no longer reverts.
Change the loop bound to i < _tos.length - 1 so the last recipient is never processed.
Ignore a failed transferFrom call instead of reverting, so failed transfers no longer revert the whole call.
Return false instead of true on successful completion.
Move the return true statement into the loop body so the function returns after the first transfer instead of transferring to all recipients.
